_comment: What each property IS: its type, how the remote spells its booleans, and what it means. Shared, because AlwaysOn is the same idea on any Harmony. WHICH properties a given model has - and what its firmware does with them - is per model and lives in library/remotes/<model>.json, because the sets differ: a remote can have options the 900 does not, and the 900 has options it does not.

ActivityStartPage.description: Which touchscreen page the activity opens on.
ActivityStartPage.label: Start page

ChannelButtonBehaviour.description: What the channel buttons do in this activity.
ChannelButtonBehaviour.label: Channel buttons

HideModeControl.description: Hide the Control page in this activity.
HideModeControl.label: Hide Control page

MaxTvContentDays.description: How many days of programme guide to keep.
MaxTvContentDays.label: Guide days

PlayOnEnter.description: Send Play when the activity starts.
PlayOnEnter.label: Play on start

PowerOffUnusedDevices.description: Turn off devices this activity does not use.
PowerOffUnusedDevices.label: Power off unused devices

RetainStop.description: Keep the stopped state when leaving.
RetainStop.label: Retain stop

ScrollChannelsByPage.description: Page through channels instead of one at a time.
ScrollChannelsByPage.label: Scroll channels by page

ScrollShowsByPage.description: Page through shows instead of one at a time.
ScrollShowsByPage.label: Scroll shows by page

StopOnExit.description: Send Stop when the activity ends.
StopOnExit.label: Stop on exit

TrainingWheels.description: Show the remote's built-in help prompts in this activity.
TrainingWheels.label: Show help prompts

UnusedDevicesHelp.description: Offer help about devices this activity does not use.
UnusedDevicesHelp.label: Unused-device help

AlwaysOn.description: You keep this device switched on. Activities will not touch its power at all. Set on the Timing page, beside the other power settings.
AlwaysOn.label: Always on

Dimmer.description: The lighting controller supports dimming, not just on/off.
Dimmer.label: Has a dimmer

IsDisplayDevice.description: This device is a screen, so activities can use it in the DISPLAY role.
IsDisplayDevice.label: Is a display

IsNewDevice.description: Set when a device has just been added; the remote clears it itself. Not a setting - it is written for you.
IsNewDevice.label: Newly added

ManualPower.description: The remote has no way to switch this device, so it asks you instead of trying.
ManualPower.label: Manual power

MenuOnDevice.description: The device has its own on-screen menu.
MenuOnDevice.label: Menu on device

NumCassettes.description: How many cassettes the changer holds.
NumCassettes.label: Cassette slots

NumDiscs.description: How many discs the changer holds.
NumDiscs.label: Disc slots

NumLights.description: How many lights this controller drives.
NumLights.label: Lights

OnScreenGuide.description: The device provides a programme guide.
OnScreenGuide.label: On-screen guide

PvrType.description: Which recorder behaviour the remote assumes.
PvrType.label: Recorder type

RecordMedia Fixed Disc.description: The recorder writes to a built-in disc.
RecordMedia Fixed Disc.label: Records to disc

Scart.help: This device is connected by SCART, so switching it on makes the television switch to it by itself. The remote powers SCART devices first and waits for them to settle before running the rest of the activity.
Scart.label: SCART auto-switching

TunerInput.description: Always the word "Tuner" in every configuration seen, and on most devices it does not name any input they actually have. Read by the touchscreen, not by the remote's behaviour. What it changes has not been established.
TunerInput.label: Tuner input
